description: Defines classes and methods for representing and parsing DNS record RDATA types, including SRV, A, AAAA, CNAME, PTR, TXT, and NSEC records, within the Chromium project's networking code.

classes.name: RecordRdata
classes.description: Abstract base class for DNS record RDATA representations, providing interface for equality and type identification.

classes.name: SrvRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents SRV DNS record data, including priority, weight, port, and target domain.

classes.name: ARecordRdata
classes.description: Represents IPv4 address DNS record data.

classes.name: AAAARecordRdata
classes.description: Represents IPv6 address DNS record data.

classes.name: CnameRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents CNAME DNS record data, storing the canonical name.

classes.name: PtrRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents PTR DNS record data, storing the domain name.

classes.name: TxtRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents TXT DNS record data, storing one or more text strings.

classes.name: NsecRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents NSEC DNS record data, including bitmap for RR types.

methods.name: HasValidSize
methods.description: Checks if the given data has a valid size for the specified DNS record type.

methods.name: IsEqual
methods.description: Pure virtual method to compare two RDATA objects for equality.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the DNS record type identifier.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create RDATA objects from raw data.

methods.name: priority
methods.description: Returns the priority value for SRV records.

methods.name: weight
methods.description: Returns the weight value for SRV records.

methods.name: port
methods.description: Returns the port number for SRV records.

methods.name: target
methods.description: Returns the target domain name for SRV records.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Returns the IP address for A and AAAA records.

methods.name: cname
methods.description: Returns the canonical name for CNAME records.

methods.name: ptrdomain
methods.description: Returns the domain name for PTR records.

methods.name: texts
methods.description: Returns the list of text strings for TXT records.

methods.name: bitmap_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the bitmap in bits for NSEC records.

methods.name: GetBit
methods.description: Checks if a specific RR type bit is set in the NSEC bitmap.
